topic: Maintenance of O2 system, servicing and safety precautions
syllabus_extract: Maintenance of O2 system, servicing and safety precautions. Safety measures while handling /upkeep of gaseous oxygen system. Quality checks on pressurized gas cylinders.
specific_objectives: 17.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the need of oxygen systems, types of systems, working principles of components.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of O2 cylinder quality checks and safety valve inspection; Instructor supervision of trainee handling procedures.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the aircraft oxygen system?
List two critical safety precautions when handling gaseous oxygen.
Why must oil or grease be strictly avoided on oxygen equipment?

summary_questions: Explain the correct procedure for checking the hydrostatic test date on an O2 cylinder.
Describe the immediate actions required if a leak is detected in the cabin O2 system.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the specific safety precautions required when servicing gaseous oxygen cylinders, referencing the next lesson on cabin pressurization systems.
